main_body: A rectangular hedge/grass block: a light green top band (mottled leaf texture) over a darker green front face with a dark base row.
top_band: light green #80ad54 with #a6c977 highlights, rows 1-6 at x=16 (front-edge highlight line at row 6), under a dark outline at row 0
evidence: Column x=16: row 0 outline, rows 1-5 light green top (5 rows), row 6 lighter front-edge highlight, row 7 dark shadow line, rows 8-10 mid green and rows 11-14 deep green front face. A clear top band and a front face are both drawn with a step of more than 60 L between them, so it reads as a 3/4 hedge block. Recessed front is not applicable to an organic hedge, and the dark row 7 acts as the eave shadow.

style.evidence: The candidate has only 8 distinct colours and a median of 8 per tile, against 38-40 distinct colours and 17-20 per tile for the references. The dark edge pixels are tinted green (4% neutral), so the outline is fine, and the top has a checkered mottle of several greens with no flat 5x5 areas. The front face is a dark, low-contrast mass with little detail, and the whole piece is a flat, simple slab of two ramps with a thin shading range. Next to the richly detailed stall and well it looks thinner and flatter.
